    </a>
    <ul class="mh-tags"><li class="mh-tag">Strategy</li><li class="mh-tag">Visual identity</li><li class="mh-tag">Editorial</li></ul>
  </li>
  <li class="mh-project-card">
    <a class="mh-project-card__link" href="#">
      <div class="mh-project-card__meta mh-label"><span>6</span><span>/</span><span class="mh-flip"><span class="mh-flip__track"><span>National Park Playing Cards</span><span aria-hidden="true">National Park Playing Cards</span></span></span></div>

### Three columns (Other projects)

```html example
<ul class="mh-project-grid" data-columns="3">
  <li class="mh-project-card"><a class="mh-project-card__link" href="#"><div class="mh-project-card__meta mh-label"><span>2</span><span>/</span><span class="mh-flip"><span class="mh-flip__track"><span>AirPods Pro 3</span><span aria-hidden="true">AirPods Pro 3</span></span></span></div><div class="mh-media" data-stroke><img src="../../assets/samples/airpods.jpg" alt=""></div></a></li>
  <li class="mh-project-card"><a class="mh-project-card__link" href="#"><div class="mh-project-card__meta mh-label"><span>3</span><span>/</span><span class="mh-flip"><span class="mh-flip__track"><span>Peak Energy</span><span aria-hidden="true">Peak Energy</span></span></span></div><div class="mh-media"><img src="../../assets/samples/peak-energy.jpg" alt=""></div></a></li>
  <li class="mh-project-card"><a class="mh-project-card__link" href="#"><div class="mh-project-card__meta mh-label"><span>4</span><span>/</span><span class="mh-flip"><span class="mh-flip__track"><span>Gaia</span><span aria-hidden="true">Gaia</span></span></span></div><div class="mh-media"><img src="../../assets/samples/gaia.jpg" alt=""></div></a></li>
</ul>
```

## Usage

| Columns | Desktop | Tablet | Mobile | Where |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2 (default) | 2 | 2 | 1 | Home selected work |
| `data-columns="3"` | 3 | 2 | 1 | Case-study "Other projects", `/index` grid view |

- Gaps: 20px between columns, 50px between rows.
- Home shows exactly six projects (three rows of two), followed by a right-aligned "View all" action.
- "Other projects" shows three and drops tags.

## API

| Attribute | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `class="mh-project-grid"` | 2-column grid, use on `ul`/`div` |
| `data-columns="3"` | 3 columns on desktop |

## Framer mapping

- Home: `HomeSelectedWorkGrid` (`FecepLS`) renders the grid itself (`gap: 50px 20px`).
- `/index` grid view: `IndexPage` (`rgAZFOv`) with the `figma` layout variant supplied by `IndexPageGridPreview` (`LgIzFjJ`): 3 columns, 56px row gap, 20px column gap.
- In native Framer layouts, use a Grid with `1fr` columns and the gap tokens; set column count on the tablet and phone breakpoints.

## Don't

- Don't use masonry or mixed card sizes in these grids. Galleries inside case studies have their own components.
- Don't paginate; use the Index for the full list.

# Index List

## Anatomy

| Column | Content | Type | Below 1200px | Below 810px |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Year | Group label, first column, once per group | Title, 22px | Kept | Stacked above rows |
| Title | Project name, uppercase, flips on hover | Title, 22px | Kept | 16px |
| Discipline | Comma-joined disciplines | Mono label | Hidden | Hidden |
| Industry | One industry | Mono label, right-aligned | Kept | Kept |

## Usage

- Groups are years, newest first. A full-width rule opens each group; rules separate rows inside it; a final rule closes the list.
- Text is near-black (`--mh-text-strong`), not Forest Green. This is the one dense, data-like surface on the site.
- Row hover: a 4% near-black wash (150ms Smooth) plus the title flip (620ms Snappy).
- The list sits under the [Filter Group](filter-group.md) and the [View Toggle](view-toggle.md); filtering hides rows and empty groups without moving the filters.

## API

| Class | Element | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mh-index` | `ol` | Wrapper; `reversed` if numbering matters |
| `mh-index__group` | `li` | Grid `1fr 5fr`, top rule |
| `mh-index__year` | `h3` | Year label |
| `mh-index__rows` | `ul` | Rows, divided by rules |
| `mh-index__row` | `a` | Grid `2fr 2fr 1fr`; hover wash, 2px radius |
| `mh-index__title` | `span` | Holds a flip rail (`--mh-flip-h: 1.2em`) |
| `mh-index__discipline`, `mh-index__industry` | `span.mh-label` | Ellipsis on overflow |

## Data model (CMS)

```json
{ "title": "Gaia", "slug": "gaia", "year": 2026, "category1": "Visual identity", "category2": "UX/UI", "category3": "Strategy", "industry": "Nature", "sortOrder": 2 }
```

Fields map to `All Projects` (`yTHrQWMIY`). Years come from the CMS; never hard-code groups.

## Accessibility

- Year headings make the groups navigable by heading.
- Each row is a single link whose name is the project title (duplicate flip span is hidden).

## Framer mapping

- `IndexPage` (`rgAZFOv`), mounted through `IndexPageGridPreview` (`LgIzFjJ`). Text and dividers render `#141414` through color property controls.
- Content arrives progressively on first load (6 rows, then +12 per frame); filter toggles never unmount the list.
- Read `docs/index-component-instructions.md` before editing. The CMS mode is generated-module only; there are no manual rows or `DEFAULT_PROJECTS`.

## Don't

- Don't add thumbnails to list rows (grid view exists for that).
- Don't color rows by discipline or industry.
- Don't use zebra striping.

title: Filter Group
section: Components

status: live
framer: IndexPage (rgAZFOv), IndexFilterContext + URL sync
codeFileId: rgAZFOv

# Filter Group

## Examples

```html example
<div class="mh-filter" aria-label="Filter projects">
  <fieldset class="mh-filter__group">
    <legend class="mh-filter__heading mh-label">Year</legend>
    <button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false" value="2026">2026</button>
    <button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false" value="2025">2025</button>
    <button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false" value="2024">2024</button>
  </fieldset>
  <fieldset class="mh-filter__group">
    <legend class="mh-filter__heading mh-label">Discipline</legend>
    <button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Packaging</button>
    <button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="true">Product</button>
    <button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Strategy</button>
    <button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Visual identity</button>
  </fieldset>
  <fieldset class="mh-filter__group">
    <legend class="mh-filter__heading mh-label">Industry</legend>
    <button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Literature</button>
    <button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Nature</button>
    <button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Technology</button>
  </fieldset>
  <button class="mh-filter__clear mh-action" type="button">Clear filters</button>
</div>
```

Click the items to toggle. "Clear filters" appears as soon as one is active.

## Usage

- Three taxonomies, in this order: **Year**, **Discipline**, **Industry**. Values come from the CMS.
- Multiple selections combine as OR within a group and AND across groups.
- Selected items turn Accent Green and get a leading dot. Hover previews the same color.
- **Clear filters** is always rendered and only toggles `visibility`, so activating a filter never shifts the layout.
- Filter state syncs to the URL: `#service=packaging` in, `?service=` out.

## API

| Class / attribute | Element | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mh-filter` | `div` | Grid `1fr 2fr 2fr 1fr` (2 columns on mobile). Gets `data-active` while any item is pressed |
| `mh-filter__group` | `fieldset` | One taxonomy |
| `mh-filter__heading` | `legend` | Muted mono heading |
| `mh-filter__item` | `button[aria-pressed]` | 13px mono, 28px line height |
| `mh-filter__clear` | `button` | Visible only with `data-active` |
| `mh:filter` event | n/a | Fired by `components.js` on change with `detail.values` |

## Accessibility

- Toggles are `<button aria-pressed>`, so state is announced.
- Group with `fieldset`/`legend` so each item is read with its taxonomy.

## Framer mapping

- `IndexPage` (`rgAZFOv`): taxonomy follows Figma node `32:7531`; hover/active color `#25593a`; URL sync has a kill switch (`ENABLE_URL_FILTER_SYNC`); grid tags toggle the same filters through `IndexFilterContext`.
- The nav fades in row by row on arrival (`INDEX_NAV_FADE_PRESET`).

## Don't

- Don't use checkboxes, dropdowns or a search field for these filters.
- Don't show result counts next to every item.

# View Toggle

## Examples

```html example
<div class="mh-view-toggle" role="group" aria-label="View" data-target="#index-demo">
  <button type="button" value="grid" aria-pressed="false">Grid</button>
  <span aria-hidden="true">/</span>
  <button type="button" value="list" aria-pressed="true">List</button>
</div>
```

## Usage

- Right-aligned on the line above the list or grid it controls.
- Two options only. The active one is underlined (1px, 3px offset); there's no pill or background.
- Changing views keeps the filters and scroll position.

## API

| Class / attribute | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `mh-view-toggle` | `div role="group"`; mono label with 28px line height |
| `data-target` | Selector of the element whose `data-view` is set to the pressed button's `value` |
| `button[aria-pressed]` | One pressed at a time (`components.js`) |

## Framer mapping

- The live toggle sits inside `IndexPage` (`rgAZFOv`, `.idx-view-toggle`) with a -46px offset so it shares a line with the filters; `IndexPageGridPreview` (`LgIzFjJ`) exposes the default **View** control.

## Don't

- Don't use icons (grid/list glyphs) for this toggle.
- Don't add a third view.

# Meta Grid

## Examples

```html example
<div class="mh-meta-grid">
  <dl class="mh-meta-grid__col">
    <div class="mh-meta-grid__item">
      <dt class="mh-label" data-leading="relaxed">/ About the project</dt>
      <dd class="mh-text-body-lg">A photograph becomes a data point. A data point becomes a record. A record becomes a reason to care. Gaia is a rebrand and redesign of iNaturalist, turning the world's largest biodiversity platform from a tool for experts into an open invitation to notice and protect the living world.</dd>
    </div>
    <div class="mh-meta-grid__item">
      <dt class="mh-label" data-leading="relaxed">/ Industry</dt>
      <dd class="mh-text-body-lg">Nature</dd>
    </div>
  </dl>
  <dl class="mh-meta-grid__col">
    <div class="mh-meta-grid__item">
      <dt class="mh-label" data-leading="relaxed">/ Scope</dt>
      <dd class="mh-text-body-lg">Visual Identity, UX/UI, Strategy</dd>
    </div>
    <div class="mh-meta-grid__item">
      <dt class="mh-label" data-leading="relaxed">/ Credits</dt>
      <dd class="mh-text-body-lg">Client: Self-Initiated Proposal<br>Designer: Micah Hoang</dd>
    </div>
    <div class="mh-meta-grid__item">
      <dt class="mh-label" data-leading="relaxed">/ Year</dt>
      <dd class="mh-text-body-lg">2026</dd>
    </div>
  </dl>
</div>
```

## Usage

- Sits directly under the case-study hero media.
- **Left column**: About the project (the lead paragraph), then Industry.
- **Right column**: Scope, Credits, Year.
- Labels start with `/ `. Values are Body L in near-black.
- Credits are exact and one per line: `Role: Name`. Name collaborators; say "Designer: Micah Hoang" only if that's true.

## API

| Class | Element | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mh-meta-grid` | `div` | Two columns, 30px gap; stacks below 810px |
| `mh-meta-grid__col` | `dl` | 40px between items |
| `mh-meta-grid__item` | `div` | `dt` label + `dd` value, 16px gap |

## Data model (CMS)

```json
{ "about": "A photograph becomes a data point…", "industry": "Nature", "scope": ["Visual Identity", "UX/UI", "Strategy"], "credits": [{ "role": "Client", "name": "Self-Initiated Proposal" }, { "role": "Designer", "name": "Micah Hoang" }], "year": 2026 }
```

## Framer mapping

- Native case-study "Descriptor" section on each bespoke `/case-studies/{slug}` page.
- On mobile, `CaseStudyMobileDescriptorLayout` (`W62Sy75`) reorders the descriptor columns. Keep the same DOM order (About, Industry, Scope, Credits, Year) so it works.

## Don't

- Don't render the meta as a table with borders.
- Don't add icons or pills to values.

# Lightbox

## Examples

Click any image to open the viewer. Use ← → to step through and Esc to close.

```html example
<div class="mh-split" data-mh-lightbox>
  <div class="mh-media"><img src="../../assets/samples/gaia.jpg" alt="Gaia app on a phone in a field of daisies"></div>
  <div class="mh-media"><img src="../../assets/samples/peak-energy.jpg" alt="Peak Energy battery modules, line illustration"></div>
</div>
```

## Usage

- Opt in a gallery or section by adding `data-mh-lightbox` to its container; every `img` inside becomes openable and steppable.
- Backdrop is white, chrome is near-black at weight 300, 24px. No counter by default.
- Zoom is 260ms Snappy and starts **from the clicked thumbnail**: the live component clones the media over its source rect, keeps it opaque, and zooms it to full size while the white backdrop fades in. The `components.js` version here is a simplified center scale (0.96 → 1); match the live behavior, not the demo.
- Tapping the image advances; navigation loops.
- 72px padding around the media on desktop, 16px on mobile.

## API

| Hook | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `data-mh-lightbox` (container) | Images inside open the lightbox (`components.js`) |
| `.mh-lightbox[data-open]` | Generated overlay; `role="dialog"` `aria-modal="true"` |
| `.mh-lightbox__btn[data-dir]` | `prev`, `next`, `close` |

## Accessibility

- Focus moves to Close on open and returns to the clicked image on close.
- Esc closes; arrow keys step. Page scroll is locked while open.
- Buttons have `aria-label`s; the image keeps its `alt`.

## Framer mapping

- `CaseStudyLightbox` (`F2K4_SV`), loaded by `CaseStudyControllers` (`z13WRHS`) at a pinned module hash. If you republish the lightbox, bump the pinned hash in the controller.
- Controls (defaults): Background `rgb(255,255,255)`, Arrows/X `rgb(20,20,20)`, Icon Weight 300, Icon Size 24px, Zoom 260ms, Padding 72px, Tap = Next on, Loop on, Counter off, Videos on.
- The lightbox sits outside Lenis smooth scrolling (`data-lenis-prevent`).

## Don't

- Don't darken the backdrop; the viewer is white like a light table.
- Don't add captions, thumbnails strips or share buttons.

classes: [mh-testimonial, mh-testimonial__quote, mh-testimonial__cite, mh-testimonial__name, mh-testimonial__role, mh-testimonial__controls]

# Testimonial

## Examples

```html example
<figure class="mh-testimonial" data-items='[{"quote":"Micah turned a loose brief into a system the whole team could build on.","name":"Client Name","role":"Creative Director, Studio"},{"quote":"Every decision came with a reason, and every reason held up.","name":"Second Client","role":"Head of Brand, Company"}]'>
  <p class="mh-label">What our clients say:</p>
  <blockquote class="mh-testimonial__quote">Micah turned a loose brief into a system the whole team could build on.</blockquote>
  <figcaption class="mh-testimonial__cite">
    <span class="mh-testimonial__name">Client Name</span>
    <span class="mh-testimonial__role">Creative Director, Studio</span>
  </figcaption>
  <div class="mh-testimonial__controls mh-label">
    <button class="mh-action" type="button" data-dir="prev" aria-label="Previous testimonial">←</button>
    <button class="mh-action" type="button" data-dir="next" aria-label="Next testimonial">→</button>
  </div>
</figure>
```

The quotes above are placeholders. Use only real, attributed quotes.

## Usage

- Quote in GT Standard Regular, 48px with 1.12 leading (×0.8 on tablet, ×0.62 on mobile), max 820px wide.
- Name 20px, role 16px muted. Label 13px mono above.
- Arrows are typed characters (← →) in mono, not icons. Autoplay is off.
- On mobile the live component clamps long quotes to 6 lines with a "Read more".
- Lines reveal one by one (mask rise) when the quote changes.

## API

| Class / attribute | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `mh-testimonial` | `figure`; `data-items` JSON array of `{quote, name, role}` enables stepping |
| `mh-testimonial__quote` | `blockquote` |
| `mh-testimonial__cite` | `figcaption` with `__name` and `__role` |
| `[data-dir="prev" \| "next"]` | Step buttons |

## Framer mapping

- `TestimonialLineReveal` (`tpDdaaJ`). Controls: Label ("What our clients say:"), Arrows (← →), Autoplay off / 5s, Align left, Mobile Read More on, Clamp Lines 6, Max Width 820, Quote Size 48, Tablet Scale 0.8, Mobile Scale 0.62, Quote Leading 1.12, Name Size 20, Role Size 16, Label Size 13.

## Don't

- Don't use quotation-mark graphics, avatars or star ratings.
- Don't invent or paraphrase testimonials.

# Scroll to Top

## Examples

```html example
<button class="mh-action mh-scroll-top" type="button">
  <span class="mh-flip"><span class="mh-flip__track"><span>Scroll to top ↑</span><span aria-hidden="true">Scroll to top ↑</span></span></span>
</button>
```

## Usage

- Place it at the end of long pages (Home, About), right-aligned above the footer.
- 900ms with a Snappy-like curve. Jumps instantly under reduced motion.

## API

| Class / attribute | Notes |
| --- | --- |

## Framer mapping

- Don't show it on short pages.

<!-- content/components/page-loader.md -->

---
title: Page Loader
section: Components
order: 20
description: The first-visit boot curtain. Forest Green, a Cream progress bar, the name centered, then a lift.
status: live
framer: PageTransition (gmalnRr) + PageTransitionRuntime (rdTIUkW)
codeFileId: gmalnRr
classes: [mh-loader, mh-loader__bar, mh-loader__identity]
tokens: [color.primitive.forest-green, color.primitive.cream, motion.duration.page, z.loader]
---

# Page Loader

## Examples

```html example bleed
<div class="ds-demo-frame">
  <div class="mh-loader" data-contained>
    <span class="mh-loader__bar"></span>
    <p class="mh-loader__identity">Micah Hoang ©2026</p>
  </div>
  <button class="mh-action" data-variant="pill" type="button" data-play-loader style="position:absolute;right:16px;bottom:16px;color:var(--mh-text-brand)">Replay</button>
</div>
```

Press **Replay** to run the sequence.

## Sequence

| Step | What happens | Timing |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. Boot | Forest Green covers the viewport; "Micah Hoang ©2026" centered in Cream | Painted at parse time, before the app hydrates |
| 2. Progress | An 8px Cream bar fills from the left along the top edge | ≥ 1200ms (`bootMinMs`), Smooth |
| 3. Identity out | The name fades | 420ms, during bar completion |
| 4. Lift | The curtain slides up and off | 1200ms, Snappy |

## Usage

- **Home only, first visit only** (direct entries and reloads of `/`). Never on internal navigations, case studies or mobile ≤ the boot-disable width.
- The identity uses the Heading style: 30 / 24 / 19px, 120% leading, -1% tracking.
- `theme-color` and the page canvas are synced to Cream, so mobile browser chrome doesn't flash green afterward.
- Videos behind the curtain hold until it lifts.

## API

| Class / attribute | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `mh-loader` | Fixed full-viewport curtain. `data-contained` makes it `position:absolute` for previews |
| `mh-loader__bar` | 8px progress bar (scaleX) |
| `mh-loader__identity` | Centered name |
| `data-state` | `idle` → `loading` → `done` → `lifted` |
| `data-autoplay` / `window.mhPlayLoader(el)` | Run the sequence (`components.js`) |

## Framer mapping

- `PageTransition` (`gmalnRr`) owns the boot loader and every route transition (view-transition curtain, prerender speculation rules, appear replay). Controls: `Boot` Show/Off, `Boot mode` Auto/Always, `Boot color` `#233324`, `Bar color` `#F7F5F0`, `Bar height` 8px, `bootMinMs` 1200.
- Read `docs/framer-page-transition.md` before changing anything here. **Don't build a second loader or transition layer.**

## Don't

- Don't show percentages, spinners or a logo animation.
- Don't run the loader on every navigation.

<!-- content/components/grain-overlay.md -->

---
title: Grain Overlay
section: Components
order: 21
description: The page-level SVG film grain, fixed under the nav, multiplied at 10%, with an optional 16fps shimmer.
status: live
framer: GrainOverlay (MhR7Ukl)
codeFileId: MhR7Ukl
classes: [mh-grain]
tokens: [texture.grain.*, layout.nav-height, z.grain]
---

# Grain Overlay

## Examples

The preview below boosts opacity to 0.35 so the grain is visible; the brand value is 0.1.

```html example bleed
<div class="ds-demo-frame" style="height:220px">
  <div style="padding:40px"><p class="mh-text-display-m" style="margin:0">Selected work</p></div>
  <div class="mh-grain" data-contained data-animate style="opacity:.35">
    <svg aria-hidden="true">
      <filter id="mh-grain-filter" x="0" y="0" width="100%" height="100%" color-interpolation-filters="sRGB">
        <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="1.14" numOctaves="4" stitchTiles="stitch" seed="7"/>
        <feComponentTransfer>
          <feFuncR type="linear" slope="2.35" intercept="-0.58"/>
          <feFuncG type="linear" slope="2.35" intercept="-0.58"/>
          <feFuncB type="linear" slope="2.35" intercept="-0.58"/>
        </feComponentTransfer>
        <feColorMatrix type="saturate" values="0"/>
        <feColorMatrix type="matrix" values="0.314 0 0 0 0  0.114 0 0 0 0  0.027 0 0 0 0  0 0 0 0 1"/>
      </filter>
      <rect width="100%" height="100%" filter="url(#mh-grain-filter)"/>
    </svg>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Page snippet

Place once, as the last child of `body`:

```html
<div class="mh-grain" data-animate aria-hidden="true">
  <svg><filter id="mh-grain" x="0" y="0" width="100%" height="100%" color-interpolation-filters="sRGB">
    <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="1.14" numOctaves="4" stitchTiles="stitch" seed="7"/>
    <feComponentTransfer><feFuncR type="linear" slope="2.35" intercept="-0.58"/><feFuncG type="linear" slope="2.35" intercept="-0.58"/><feFuncB type="linear" slope="2.35" intercept="-0.58"/></feComponentTransfer>
    <feColorMatrix type="saturate" values="0"/>
    <feColorMatrix type="matrix" values="0.314 0 0 0 0  0.114 0 0 0 0  0.027 0 0 0 0  0 0 0 0 1"/>
  </filter><rect width="100%" height="100%" filter="url(#mh-grain)"/></svg>
</div>
```

The last matrix multiplies the grey noise by the umber `#501D07` (80/255, 29/255, 7/255).

## Usage

- One per page. Fixed, `pointer-events: none`, starting at `--mh-nav-height` so the nav stays clean.
- `data-animate` re-seeds the noise at 16fps; it stops under reduced motion.
- During page transitions the live site runs the grain full height so no blank strip shows before the nav arrives.

## API

| Attribute | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `class="mh-grain"` | Fixed layer: opacity 0.1, multiply, `z-index: var(--mh-z-grain)` |
| `data-contained` | Absolute inside a positioned parent (previews) |
| `data-animate` | 16fps shimmer (`components.js`) |

## Framer mapping

- `GrainOverlay` (`MhR7Ukl`) portals a fixed layer to `<body>`. Controls: Grain on, Clear Nav on, Grain Opacity 0.1, Blend multiply, Color `#501d07`, Exposure -0.58, Contrast 2.35, Grain Size 1.14, Detail 4, Animate on, Shimmer FPS 16, Z-Index 10.
- On `/play` and `/play-hover-preview` the instance is static outside WebKit and `disableOnWebKit=true`. Keep it that way (Play performance contract).

## Don't

- Don't add grain to individual components or images.
- Don't use a PNG noise texture instead.

# Home

## Goal

A senior design lead should get the read in ten seconds: **brand designer, systems thinker, high craft, real shipped work.** Home shows six projects, not all of them.

## Structure

| # | Section | Components | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | Boot (first visit) | [Page Loader](../components/page-loader.md) | Home only |
| 1 | Nav | [Navigation](../components/navigation.md) | Same as every page |
| 2 | Hero | [Hero](../components/hero.md) (home) | Name, two-line descriptor, link list + ©2026, rule |
| 3 | Selected work | [Section Header](../components/section-header.md), [Project Grid](../components/project-grid.md) | 6 projects, 2 columns, "View all" right-aligned below |
| 4 | About Micah | Section Header, portrait [Media Frame](../components/media-frame.md), Body L, [Action](../components/action.md) "Read more" | Portrait left, copy right. Hovering the image or the link triggers both (image scale + link flip) |
| 5 | Scroll to top | [Scroll to Top](../components/scroll-to-top.md) | Right-aligned |
| 6 | Footer | [Footer](../components/footer.md) | Forest Green |
| n/a | Texture | [Grain Overlay](../components/grain-overlay.md) | Page-level |

## Example (condensed)

```html example bleed

    <h1 class="mh-hero__name mh-text-display-xl">Micah Hoang</h1>
    <p class="mh-hero__descriptor mh-text-heading">Brand designer with a systems mind.</p>
    <div class="mh-hero__bar">
      <ul class="mh-link-list mh-label"><li><a class="mh-link" href="#">LinkedIn</a></li><li><a class="mh-link" href="#">Resume</a></li><li><a class="mh-link" href="#">Email</a></li><li><a class="mh-link" href="#">Cosmos</a></li></ul>
      <span class="mh-label">©2026</span>
    </div>
  </header>
  <section style="margin-top:72px">
    <h2 class="mh-text-display-m" style="margin:0 0 72px">Selected work</h2>
    <ul class="mh-project-grid">
      <li class="mh-project-card"><a class="mh-project-card__link" href="#"><div class="mh-project-card__meta mh-label"><span>1</span><span>/</span><span class="mh-flip"><span class="mh-flip__track"><span>Gaia</span><span aria-hidden="true">Gaia</span></span></span></div><div class="mh-media"><img src="../../assets/samples/gaia.jpg" alt=""></div></a><ul class="mh-tags"><li class="mh-tag">Visual identity</li><li class="mh-tag">UX/UI</li></ul></li>
      <li class="mh-project-card"><a class="mh-project-card__link" href="#"><div class="mh-project-card__meta mh-label"><span>2</span><span>/</span><span class="mh-flip"><span class="mh-flip__track"><span>AirPods Pro 3</span><span aria-hidden="true">AirPods Pro 3</span></span></span></div><div class="mh-media" data-stroke><img src="../../assets/samples/airpods.jpg" alt=""></div></a><ul class="mh-tags"><li class="mh-tag">2D motion</li><li class="mh-tag">3D motion</li></ul></li>
    </ul>
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:40px"><a class="mh-action" href="#"><span class="mh-flip"><span class="mh-flip__track"><span>View all</span><span aria-hidden="true">View all</span></span></span></a></div>
  </section>
</div>
```

## Rules

- **Selected-work order** is a curation decision (current: Gaia, AirPods Pro 3, Peak Energy, Motion Connect 2025, Simon & Schuster, National Park Playing Cards). It comes from the CMS, not code.
- Six projects, never more. Everything else lives in the Index.
- No hero image. The first image a visitor sees is project 1.
- Vertical rhythm: about 144px from hero to Selected work, 72px from section title to grid, 144px before About.

## Framer mapping

- Selected work: `HomeSelectedWorkGrid` (`FecepLS`), which also owns the About portrait/link linked hover.
- Boot and transitions: `PageTransition` (`gmalnRr`).
- Home social labels: `TextEncryptionEffect` (`p7tSTaD`).

<!-- content/patterns/case-study.md -->

---
title: Case Study
section: Patterns
order: 2
description: The template every project page follows. Two-tone title, full-bleed media, fact sheet, then titled chapters of media and short text.
status: live
framer: Bespoke pages /case-studies/{slug} (one per CMS item)
---

# Case Study

## Goal

Show the work in context and say exactly what Micah did. The media carries the story; text is short, specific and in the first person.

## Structure

| # | Section | Components | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Nav | [Navigation](../components/navigation.md) | |
| 2 | Title | [Hero](../components/hero.md) (case-study) | Bold project name + Light Gray continuation, Display L |
| 3 | Hero media | [Media Frame](../components/media-frame.md) | Full bleed (edge to edge, no gutter), 16:9 or wider, video preferred |
| 4 | Fact sheet | [Meta Grid](../components/meta-grid.md) | About, Industry / Scope, Credits, Year |
| 5…n | Chapters | Heading (35px, near-black) + galleries + Body (18px, Graphite, ≤620px) | e.g. The Insight, Strategy, Visual Identity, Brand in the World, Interface, Designed to Ship |
| | Testimonial | [Testimonial](../components/testimonial.md) | Optional, real quotes only |
| n+1 | Other projects | [Section Header](../components/section-header.md), [Project Grid](../components/project-grid.md) `data-columns="3"` | Three projects, no tags |
| n+2 | Footer | [Footer](../components/footer.md) | |

Every image on the page is [Lightbox](../components/lightbox.md)-enabled.

## Example (condensed)

```html example bleed
<article>
  <header class="mh-hero mh-container" data-variant="case-study" style="padding-top:72px;padding-bottom:72px">
    <h1 class="mh-hero__name">Gaia <span class="mh-hero__continuation">Turning noticing into a way of caring for the living world.</span></h1>
  </header>
  <div class="mh-media" data-ratio="16:9" data-mh-lightbox><img src="../../assets/samples/gaia.jpg" alt="Gaia app on a phone resting on a mirror in a field of daisies"></div>
  <div class="mh-container" style="padding-block:40px 72px">
    <div class="mh-meta-grid">
      <dl class="mh-meta-grid__col"><div class="mh-meta-grid__item"><dt class="mh-label" data-leading="relaxed">/ About the project</dt><dd class="mh-text-body-lg">A photograph becomes a data point. A data point becomes a record. A record becomes a reason to care.</dd></div></dl>
      <dl class="mh-meta-grid__col"><div class="mh-meta-grid__item"><dt class="mh-label" data-leading="relaxed">/ Scope</dt><dd class="mh-text-body-lg">Visual Identity, UX/UI, Strategy</dd></div><div class="mh-meta-grid__item"><dt class="mh-label" data-leading="relaxed">/ Year</dt><dd class="mh-text-body-lg">2026</dd></div></dl>
    </div>
    <section style="margin-top:96px">
      <h2 class="mh-text-heading mh-text-strong" style="margin:0 0 40px">The Insight</h2>
      <p class="mh-text-body mh-text-body mh-measure" style="margin:0">iNaturalist lets people photograph an organism, record where they found it, and share it with a community that helps identify it.</p>
    </section>
  </div>
</article>
```

## Rules

- **Title**: the project name plus one line of what it does for people, in the visitor's terms. Under about 12 words in the continuation.
- **Chapters**: 4–7 chapters, each a Heading (sentence or Title Case as on the live pages), one gallery, and 1–3 short paragraphs. Paragraphs sit beside or under media, max 620px.
- **Text color**: chapter headings near-black (`--mh-text-strong`), body Graphite (`--mh-text-body`), meta values near-black.
- **Media first**: lead each chapter with media. Galleries use the case-study gallery components (justified grid, double stack, matched pair); don't invent new layouts.
- **Credits**: name collaborators and agencies precisely.
- **Work in progress**: unfinished case studies are gated by `CaseStudyWorkInProgressGate` (`Vu82U8E`); see `docs/case-study-wip-gate.md`.

## Framer mapping

- Each case study is a bespoke page per CMS item (`All Projects`, `yTHrQWMIY`); see `docs/case-study-cms-workflow.md` and `docs/case-study-seo-settings.md`.
- Page-wide controllers: `CaseStudyControllers` (`z13WRHS`, lightbox + link repair), `CaseStudyVideoManager` (`rGMwETR`), `CaseStudyMobileDescriptorLayout` (`W62Sy75`).
- Galleries: `CaseStudyJustifiedMediaGrid` (`c0iPrbN`), `DoubleStackGalleryGrid`, `MatchedStackMediaPair`, `FixedHeightMediaRows` (`IthLMt_`).
- Other projects: `OtherProjectCardRestored` (`vlwa5Cz`).

<!-- content/patterns/index-archive.md -->

---
title: Index
section: Patterns
order: 3
description: The complete archive. Filters across the top, a grid/list toggle, and a ruled year-by-year list.
status: live
framer: Page "/index"; IndexPageGridPreview (LgIzFjJ) wrapping IndexPage (rgAZFOv)

# Index

## Goal

Everything Micah has made, scannable in seconds and filterable by year, discipline and industry. Home curates; the Index is the full record.

## Structure

| # | Section | Components | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Nav | [Navigation](../components/navigation.md) | |
| 2 | Title | Display M "Index" | Rises in on arrival |
| 3 | Filters | [Filter Group](../components/filter-group.md) | Year / Discipline / Industry; "Clear filters" reserved space |
| 4 | View | [View Toggle](../components/view-toggle.md) | Right-aligned: GRID / LIST |
| 5a | List view | [Index List](../components/index-list.md) | Year groups, ruled rows |
| 5b | Grid view | [Project Grid](../components/project-grid.md) `data-columns="3"` | Cards with tags; tags toggle filters |
| 6 | Footer | [Footer](../components/footer.md) | |

## Example (condensed)

```html example bleed
<div class="mh-container" style="padding-block:40px 72px">
  <h1 class="mh-text-display-m" style="margin:0 0 72px">Index</h1>
  <div class="mh-filter" style="margin-bottom:40px">
    <fieldset class="mh-filter__group"><legend class="mh-filter__heading mh-label">Year</legend><button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">2026</button><button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">2025</button></fieldset>
    <fieldset class="mh-filter__group"><legend class="mh-filter__heading mh-label">Discipline</legend><button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Visual identity</button><button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">2D motion</button></fieldset>
    <fieldset class="mh-filter__group"><legend class="mh-filter__heading mh-label">Industry</legend><button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Nature</button><button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Technology</button></fieldset>
    <button class="mh-filter__clear mh-action" type="button">Clear filters</button>
  </div>
  <div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:16px">
    <div class="mh-view-toggle" role="group" aria-label="View"><button type="button" value="grid" aria-pressed="false">Grid</button><span aria-hidden="true">/</span><button type="button" value="list" aria-pressed="true">List</button></div>
  </div>
  <ol class="mh-index" reversed>
    <li class="mh-index__group"><h2 class="mh-index__year">2026</h2><ul class="mh-index__rows">
      <li><a class="mh-index__row" href="#"><span class="mh-index__title"><span class="mh-flip"><span class="mh-flip__track"><span>Gaia</span><span aria-hidden="true">Gaia</span></span></span></span><span class="mh-index__discipline mh-label">Visual identity, UX/UI</span><span class="mh-index__industry mh-label">Nature</span></a></li>
      <li><a class="mh-index__row" href="#"><span class="mh-index__title"><span class="mh-flip"><span class="mh-flip__track"><span>Peak Energy</span><span aria-hidden="true">Peak Energy</span></span></span></span><span class="mh-index__discipline mh-label">Visual identity</span><span class="mh-index__industry mh-label">Technology</span></a></li>
    </ul></li>
  </ol>
</div>
```

## Rules

- List is the default view; Grid is one click away. Both read from the same CMS rows.
- Filters never move the layout: "Clear filters" is always rendered and only toggles visibility; the list doesn't remount on filter changes.
- Filter state lives in the URL (`#service=…` in, `?service=…` out) so filtered views can be shared.
- First arrival reveals content progressively (6 rows, then +12 per frame); later filter changes are instant.
- Every project in the CMS appears here, including ones not on Home.

## Framer mapping

- `IndexPageGridPreview` (`LgIzFjJ`) is the mounted wrapper and supplies `gridLayoutVariant="figma"`. Overwriting it silently breaks the grid. It wraps `IndexPage` (`rgAZFOv`).
- Read `docs/index-component-instructions.md` before any change. CMS mode is generated-module only; no `ProjectRegistrar`, manual `projects`, `DEFAULT_PROJECTS` or hard-coded media.

---
